sentences.english_hint: I report to my boss about work.
sentences.scenario: Describe giving your boss a work update.
sentences.source_note: Repeated omission of 向 when reporting to the boss; shortened from the corrected work example.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiàng wǒ de tàitai qiúhūn le.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of the missing 向 in the learner's proposal story.

sentences.scenario: In a meeting role-play, ask a secretary to check something.
sentences.source_note: Lesson dialogue chunk; the learner repeatedly struggled with the meaning and use of 让.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huì ràng nǐ zhīdào de.
sentences.scenario: Promise an update when plans become clear.
sentences.source_note: Explicit correction when the learner tried to produce 'I'll let you know.'

sentences.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, dàndànmiàn bú là.
sentences.english_hint: For me, dandan noodles aren't spicy.
sentences.scenario: Explain your own tolerance for spicy noodles.
sentences.source_note: Successful usage after repeated attempts to express perspective with 跟我.

sentences.chinese: 对我太太来说，四川菜有点辣。
sentences.pinyin: Duì wǒ tàitai lái shuō, Sìchuān cài yǒudiǎn là.
sentences.english_hint: Sichuan food is a little spicy for my wife.
sentences.source_note: Analysis models this correction from the discussion of the wife's response to Sichuan food.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chī bù chūlái shénme kǒuwèi.
sentences.english_hint: I can't make out the flavor.
sentences.scenario: Explain why very spicy food is hard to enjoy.
sentences.source_note: Teacher's corrected chunk for repeated attempts to use 口味 as a verb.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bù chūlái hǎo de jiànyì.
sentences.english_hint: I can't think of a good suggestion.
sentences.scenario: Respond when asked for ideas in a meeting.
sentences.source_note: Shortened from the analysis drill transferring the potential complement to meeting suggestions.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎng zài bā yuè jiéhūn.
sentences.english_hint: We want to get married in August.
sentences.scenario: Re-create the conversation about your original wedding plan.
sentences.source_note: Exact analysis correction of 做结婚 and misplaced 在八月; refers to the original plan.

sentences.english_hint: She went to dance class today.
sentences.scenario: Tell someone about your daughter's day.
sentences.source_note: Analysis correction replacing experiential 过 with 了 for today's dance class.

sentences.english_hint: What city do you live in?
sentences.scenario: Ask a new acquaintance where they live.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the duplicated 在 in the city question; location word order also recurred later.

sentences.english_hint: We're planning to go hiking tomorrow.
sentences.source_note: Analysis correction removing 了 from 准备 when it means planning a future action.

sentences.chinese: 我邀请家人参加生日聚会。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yāoqǐng jiārén cānjiā shēngrì jùhuì.
sentences.english_hint: I invite my family to the birthday party.
sentences.source_note: Shortened from the modeled invitation sentence, which the learner later produced successfully.

sentences.scenario: Ask for advice about studying Chinese.
sentences.source_note: Successful lesson usage while learning how to ask for suggestions; also connected to exam preparation.
